:::{#exr-rank-subadditive-practice}
#### Checking subadditivity of rank on two rank-one matrices

@thm-rank-subadditive says that $\rankf{\matr{A} + \matr{B}} \le \rankf{\matr{A}} + \rankf{\matr{B}}$
for [matrices](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix) of the same size.
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{1 & 2 \\ 2 & 4},
\qquad
\matr{B} = \sbmat{0 & 1 \\ 0 & 3}.
$$

Find $\rankf{\matr{A} + \matr{B}}$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Each of $\matr{A}$ and $\matr{B}$ has [rank](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-rank) $1$,
so @thm-rank-subadditive allows at most $2$.

:::
